signing.title: Open apps without the security warning
signing.prompt:
Since April 2026, Windows shows a security warning every time a remote app opens, unless the connection is signed by a trusted publisher.

WRApperture can set up this computer to sign the connections it creates. This needs administrator permission once. Connection files from other sources (for example, received by email) still show the warning.

Set it up now?
